title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的主线，是 agent 开始从“会回答”走向“会进入真实工作流”。Aaron Levie 认为，未来更多知识工作会被塑造成 coding-shaped，因为 agent 最擅长的正是使用和生成软件；Guillermo Rauch 展示了 subagents 和 Web Components 已经能把复杂界面行为一次性拼起来。与此同时，Jev 创始人提醒大家，模型的 benchmark 分数不等于可靠的生产力，真正重要的是知道它哪里会犯错、如何把人留在正确的环节里。

archive.title: Agent 工作流日报
archive.desc: Agent 正在进入软件、界面和企业流程，但可靠性、浏览器能力与人机协作仍决定它能走多远。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-11-15 source feeds.

sections.title: From Models to Workflows / 从模型到工作流
sections.desc: 真正的生产力不只来自模型更聪明，还来自它能否可靠地使用软件、处理上下文并嵌入工作流。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues that agents will improve faster in coding, tool use, computer use, and math than in other areas of knowledge work. The result may be that more work gets reshaped into something coding-like, because agents can generate software and operate the tools people already use.

His sharper point is that models do not need to know everything. They need to combine effective software use or generation with deep domain expertise and judgment inside a workflow. Once that combination works, many more domains become accessible.
original: More and more work just becomes coding-shaped to adapt to what agents are good at.
They really have to know how to use or generate software effectively combined with deep domain expertise to make the right judgment calls inside of workflows.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，agent 在 coding、tool use、computer use 和数学上的进步速度，会快过其他知识工作领域。结果可能不是只有少数工作被自动化，而是越来越多工作会被重塑成 coding-shaped，因为 agent 能生成软件，也能操作人们已经在用的软件。
他更关键的判断是：模型不需要什么都知道，而是要把软件使用或生成能力，和领域知识、工作流里的判断结合起来。一旦这个组合成立，更多领域都会被打开。
original: 越来越多的工作会变成 coding-shaped，以适应 agent 擅长的事情。
模型真正需要的是有效使用或生成软件的能力，加上领域知识，在工作流里做出正确判断。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch says subagents are working well enough to feel genuinely delightful. His workflow is simple: plan with the smartest model, then delegate execution to fast model subagents through a one-line instruction in AGENTS.md.
The interesting part is not the file size or the slogan. It is the division of labor: expensive reasoning for planning, cheap parallel workers for execution.
original: All my projects are built by planning with the smartest model + delegating to fast model subagents.
It's a 1-line instruction in ~/.fx/AGENTS.md.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 说，subagents 已经好用到让人觉得“非常愉快”。他的工作流很简单：用最聪明的模型做规划，再通过 AGENTS.md 里的一行指令，把执行交给速度更快的模型子代理。
有意思的不是文件只有 6.33MB，而是这套分工：昂贵的推理负责规划，便宜的并行 worker 负责执行。
original: 我的所有项目都是用最聪明的模型做规划，再把任务交给快速的模型 subagents。
这只是 ~/.fx/AGENTS.md 里的一行指令。

sections.title: Interfaces Agents Can Actually Use / Agent 真正能用的界面
sections.desc: 当 UI 的行为被做成可复用的能力，agent 不只是生成页面，而是在调用一套成熟的交互积木。

rewrite: Rauch shows a striking UI experiment built with two prompts, fx, and Gemini Argon: pure Web Components, no framework, with an agent reusing 14 UI SDK behaviors out of the box. The list includes window resizing, drag, menubar hover switching, typeahead, roving focus, scoped hotkeys, ARIA, and WebMCP agent control.
The takeaway is bigger than a flashy demo: reusable interaction behavior may become as important to agent-built software as visual components are today.
original: Two prompts of fx + Gemini Argon. Pure Web Components. No framework.

The agent reused 14 UI SDK behaviors out of the box: window resizing, drag, menubar hover-switching, typeahead, roving toolbar focus, 10-band EQ sliders, scoped hotkeys, ARIA, and WebMCP agent control.

rewrite: Rauch 展示了一个很有冲击力的 UI 实验：用两个 prompt、fx 和 Gemini Argon，纯 Web Components、不依赖 framework，agent 直接复用了 UI SDK 里 14 种现成交互能力。包括窗口缩放、拖拽、菜单 hover 切换、typeahead、roving focus、scoped hotkeys、ARIA 和 WebMCP agent control。
重点不只是 demo 很炫，而是可复用的交互行为，可能会像今天的视觉组件一样，成为 agent 构建软件时真正重要的积木。
original: 用两个 prompt、fx + Gemini Argon，纯 Web Components，不用 framework。
agent 开箱复用了 14 种 UI SDK 行为，包括窗口缩放、拖拽、菜单 hover 切换、typeahead、roving focus、scoped hotkeys、ARIA 和 WebMCP agent control。

rewrite: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan calls Aside Browser a huge unlock for every AI agent. The short post is a useful signal about where the bottleneck is moving: once agents can reliably operate a browser, the web itself becomes an available working environment.
original: Aside Browser is a huge unlock for every AI agent

rewrite: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan 认为 Aside Browser 会成为所有 AI agent 的重大解锁。虽然原文很短，但它指向了一个关键变化：一旦 agent 能可靠地操作浏览器，整个 web 就会变成它可以工作的环境。
original: Aside Browser 是所有 AI agent 的重大解锁。

sections.title: Reliability Before Autonomy / 自主之前先谈可靠
sections.desc: 模型能在某些维度超越人类，不代表它已经可以独立承担完整任务。

rewrite: Jev creator Jogo's central argument is that AI should be built for machine-native software, not treated as a string generator for human consumption. Developers know the reliability profile their applications need, so models should expose the right knobs and let use cases coevolve with them.

He is skeptical of benchmark worship and model-provider lock-in. Even systems that look superhuman on one axis still need humans in the loop, because intelligence is not a single scale and real work includes side effects, reversibility, and judgment. His practical estimate is that coding agents currently provide a decent but modest average speedup, roughly 20–40% depending on the use case.
The memorable conclusion: builders need to recover their agency and start rethinking software, interfaces, and what AI can be used to create.
original: I don't think a computer really ever wants a string ... because they operate on bits.
Intelligence as this single axis that is measured by whatever the benchmark of the day is is totally wrong.
My estimates are in the 20 to 40% speed up range.

rewrite: Jev 创始人 Jogo 的核心判断是：AI 应该服务于 machine-native software，而不是只被当成面向人类消费的字符串生成器。开发者最清楚自己的应用需要什么可靠性，所以模型应该提供足够的控制旋钮，让模型和使用场景一起演化。
他不太相信只看 benchmark，也警惕被某一家模型提供商锁死。一个系统在某个维度超越人类，不代表它能独立完成真实工作，因为 intelligence 不是单一刻度，真实工作还涉及副作用、可回滚性和判断。按他的估计，coding agent 目前平均带来的提升是不错但不巨大的 20%–40%，而且高度依赖场景。
他最后的提醒很直接：builder 要找回主动权，重新思考 software、interface，以及 AI 到底能创造什么。
original: 电脑其实很少真正需要 string，因为它们处理的是 bits。
把 intelligence 当成由当天 benchmark 测出来的单一刻度，是完全错误的。
我的估计是提速 20% 到 40%。

sections.title: Builders' New Operating Layer / Builder 的新操作层
sections.desc: 从 prompt 审计到自治企业，新的工作方式正在从个人技巧变成可重复的系统。

rewrite: Peter Yang shares two prompts for Fable 5.2: /doctor prompt-audit reviews a Claude Code setup—Claude.md, skills, and commands—and proposes fixes; /claude-api prompt-audit audits one skill in depth. His wish is that Claude Code would suggest running these audits whenever Anthropic releases a new model.
The useful idea is operational rather than flashy: treat your agent setup as software that needs regression checks after every model upgrade.
original: /doctor prompt-audit: Audits your Claude Code setup (Claude md, skills, commands) and proposes fixes.
/claude-api prompt-audit [skill name]: Audits one skill in depth.

rewrite: Peter Yang 分享了两个适用于 Fable 5.2 的 prompt：/doctor prompt-audit 会检查 Claude Code 的 Claude.md、skills 和 commands 并提出修复建议；/claude-api prompt-audit [skill name] 会深度检查某一个 skill。他希望 Claude Code 每次发布新模型时，都能自动提醒用户跑一遍审计。
真正有价值的地方不在于 prompt 很酷，而在于它把 agent 配置当成了需要回归检查的软件：模型升级后，工作流也要重新验收。
original: /doctor prompt-audit：审计 Claude Code 配置（Claude md、skills、commands）并提出修复建议。
/claude-api prompt-audit [skill name]：深度审计一个 skill。

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad states the thesis plainly: autonomous businesses are here. Read alongside his broader point that technology is recursively self-improving and AI is an accelerant, the claim is less about a single product and more about organizations whose operating loops can improve themselves.
original: Autonomous Businesses are here.

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 把判断说得很直白：自治企业已经来了。结合他关于技术会递归式自我改进、AI 只是加速器的观点，这句话不只是某个产品宣言，而是在说组织本身的运营闭环开始具备自我改进能力。
original: 自治企业已经来了。
